name: City Watch Patrol
trait: Shield Wall — when 3+ members remain, melee attacks against the group suffer +1 TN
goal: Detain suspects and escort to the magistrate.

name: Pale Vanguard Scouts
trait: Unnerving — characters who first encounter them roll Composure vs TN 10 or gain Tier 1 Shaken

name: Harvel Doss
subtitle: Regional Merchant

traits.name: Patient
traits.desc: Never deploys leverage immediately. Waits one round before using any leverage he holds.

traits.name: Good Accounts
traits.desc: Once per scene, produces specific financial information functioning as Major leverage on anyone who owes debts in the region.

goal: Establish that the Dragon Flagon property is commercially viable for redevelopment.

name: Mayor Aldous Fenn
subtitle: Voice of Goldenfields

traits.name: Institutional Weight
traits.desc: While Mayor, all Social attacks against him in Goldenfields suffer +2 TN.

traits.name: Never Says Anything Actionable
traits.desc: His attacks never generate evidence usable against him.

traits.name: Harvel in the Back
traits.desc: When Harvel Doss is present, Social Scale treated as 7.

goal: Remain the unchallenged voice of Goldenfields. Will concede tactical ground but not structural authority.

name: The Pale Shepherd
subtitle: That Which Guides the Dead

traits.name: Death Does Not Apply
traits.desc: Cannot be reduced below 1 Vitality by physical means alone. Must be unbound first (Mental extended challenge, track 8).

traits.name: Whisper Walk
traits.desc: Can appear in any location where the dead are unburied. No movement required.

traits.name: The Flock Answers
traits.desc: Once per round, may summon a Pale Vanguard Scouts mook group (Size 3) at Near range.

goal: Reclaim the valley's dead. Not malicious — operates on an ancient covenant. Will negotiate if approached through the correct rites.
